# 021: Missing template fields render as empty text

render("Hi {name}", {}) returns "Hi " and the letter goes out blank. A missing field should raise KeyError naming the field. Failing test: tests/test_render.py::test_missing_field_raises. Clear enough. Let me see render.
defaultdict(str) turns every missing field into an empty string. format_map on the plain dict raises KeyError with the field name.

import pytest
from mailmerge.render import render


def test_render_fills_fields():
    assert render("Hi {name}", {"name": "Ann"}) == "Hi Ann"


def test_missing_field_raises():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="name"):
        render("Hi {name}", {})
